notes.title: Free DLC Update 2!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26437571/207684a1b6acae57a7bf3d7aaadddd73747d8efa.png
Caverns Of The Nightjars update 2, a free DLC update for those of you itching to run, jump and glide some more.

Caverns Of The Nightjars 2 includes:

3 new levels 
New character combinations
More Collectables
New Achievements 
New Time Trial records to beat


We hope you enjoy the new content. We are looking forward to seeing your screenshots and watching you battle it out to be the fastest.
